**Klynge VEST** is a local healthcare cluster (sundhedsklynge) operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in the Danish healthcare system [^src3], [^src5]. It is one of the geographical units monitored by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to evaluate and benchmark the quality of treatment for patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. 

The cluster's clinical performance is tracked across multiple quality indicators over several years. Notably, Klynge VEST is recognized as one of the health clusters that successfully met the national standard for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy, achieving a result of 93.7% in the reported dataset [^src1]. Historically, between July 1, 2018, and June 30, 2019, the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients receiving [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] in the cluster was 83.1% [^src3]. 

More recent evaluations from the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, focus on patient safety and long-term outcomes. During this time, the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients in Klynge VEST who developed severe bleeding within one year—monitored under [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]—was 4.4% [^src6]. Furthermore, the incidence of heart failure within one year of a new diagnosis, tracked as [[indikator-15|Indikator 15]], was recorded at 4.7% [^src6]. 

By consistently reporting data on treatment coverage, bleeding complications, ischemic strokes, and mortality, Klynge VEST contributes to the RKKP's hierarchical quality improvement strategy [^src2], [^src4], [^src7]. Its localized data allows regional and national health authorities to identify specific strengths and weaknesses in clinical practice, ensuring that the treatment of atrial fibrillation aligns with national guidelines and effectively prevents complications such as stroke and heart failure [^src2], [^src7].

## Claims

- **clinical-outcome**: I perioden 01.07.2018–30.06.2019 var andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, der modtog antikoagulationsbehandling, i Klynge VEST 83,1 % (95 % CI: 73,3–90,5) [^src1] (klynge-vest, atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling) [^src3]
- **clinical-indicator**: For Klynge VEST var andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udviklede alvorlig blødning inden for 1 år, 4,4 % (95 % CI: 2,3–7,5) i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 [^src1] (indikator-11, klynge-vest) [^src6]
- **clinical-indicator**: For Klynge VEST var andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, som udviklede hjertesvigt inden for 1 år, 4,7 % (95 % CI: 2,6–8,0) i perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023 [^src1] (indikator-15, klynge-vest) [^src6]
